name: neoblocker
description: A fully offline, cross-browser AI extension that detects and blocks toxic content, hate speech, bias, and clickbait using local WASM models. No data ever leaves your device. Note: Please give the extension 2 minutes on first use after opening youtube to allow it to download the ml models. Then hard refresh the page and the exension should start.
author: Neoblocker

scripts.copy-wasm:dev: mkdir -p build/chrome-mv3-dev/wasm && cp node_modules/@xenova/transformers/dist/ort-wasm-simd.wasm build/chrome-mv3-dev/wasm/ && cp node_modules/@xenova/transformers/dist/ort-wasm.wasm build/chrome-mv3-dev/wasm/ && echo [copy-wasm:dev] done.
scripts.copy-wasm:chrome: mkdir -p build/chrome-mv3-prod/wasm && cp node_modules/@xenova/transformers/dist/ort-wasm-simd.wasm build/chrome-mv3-prod/wasm/ && cp node_modules/@xenova/transformers/dist/ort-wasm.wasm build/chrome-mv3-prod/wasm/ && echo [copy-wasm:chrome] done.
scripts.copy-wasm:firefox: mkdir -p build/firefox-mv3-prod/wasm && cp node_modules/@xenova/transformers/dist/ort-wasm-simd.wasm build/firefox-mv3-prod/wasm/ && cp node_modules/@xenova/transformers/dist/ort-wasm.wasm build/firefox-mv3-prod/wasm/ && echo [copy-wasm:firefox] done.
